heading: Applicable Codes
text: Except as otherwise expressly provided, the Construction Codes apply to applications filed on or after adoption, pending applications filed before adoption unless vested under a prior edition pursuant to Section 123, and permits or certificates issued on or after adoption subject to the stated exceptions.
exceptions: Pending applications vested under a prior edition pursuant to Section 123.

heading: Applicability of prior editions of the Construction Codes
text: The prior edition of the Construction Codes, in force on the date that a new edition of the Construction Codes is adopted pursuant to Section 122, shall remain in full force and effect for the purposes specified in Sections 123.1.1 through 123.1.5.

heading: Permits issued prior to adoption of Construction Codes
text: Work authorized by a permit issued before the effective date of the new edition of the Construction Codes, which permit has not expired pursuant to Section 105.10 or been revoked pursuant to Section 111, shall be allowed to be carried to completion under the edition of the Construction Codes under which the permit was issued, subject to the exceptions stated in Section 102.6.
exceptions: The permit must not be expired or revoked.

heading: Applications filed prior to adoption of Construction Codes
text: An application for permit for which the application filing deposit has been paid before the effective date of the new edition of the Construction Codes, pursuant to Section 108.2.1.1, shall be allowed to be processed to issuance of the permit, and any work authorized thereby shall be allowed to be carried to completion under the prior edition of the Construction Codes, subject to the exceptions stated in Section 102.6 and the following conditions: Each such application shall have been filed prior to the effective date accompanied by submittal documents and other information sufficiently complete to allow processing without substantial change or deviation; the permit shall be paid in full and obtained within 12 months after the effective date; all authorized work shall be carried to completion under the permit; and an expired or revoked permit shall not be extended under Section 105.11.
exceptions: Expired or revoked permits cannot be extended under the transition.

heading: Tenant layout permits in a new building
text: The work necessary to finish the interior layout of every tenant space in a new building authorized by a permit issued under a previous edition of the Construction Codes, for first occupancy of each such tenant space, shall be considered part of the completion of said building, and the permits for such tenant work shall be allowed to be processed under the same edition of the Construction Codes as the permit for the new building, regardless of when the tenant layout project begins.

heading: Revision of a permit issued under a prior edition
text: Revisions pursuant to Section 105.9 of an active valid permit issued under a previous edition of the Construction Codes shall be allowed to be processed, at the option of the owner, under the same edition of the Construction Codes as the permit being revised. Exceptions: Where the code official determines either of the following: 1. Using certain provisions of the previous edition would pose an undue health or safety risk to the public or the occupants of the premises. 2. The scope of work is such that submission of a new permit application is required in lieu of a permit revision as authorized by Sections 105.9 and 109.1.
exceptions: The code official determines that use of the prior edition creates an undue health or safety risk.
The scope requires a new permit application instead of a revision.
